item.moonproject.alaya_vijnana.memory: Memory cost: -1 XP level per second while drawn
item.moonproject.alaya_vijnana.hint: Right-click to switch stance | Left = Slash, sprint+Left = Smear, sneak+Left = Spill, sneak+Right = Depict | N = Heavenly Kill, M = Erase
tooltip.moonproject.exp_burner: Incinerates books, enchanted manuscripts, and fuel to refine knowledge into pure experience and ashes.
gui.moonproject.exp_burner.extract_hint: Click Extract to collect EXP (or Sneak+Right-Click)
gui.moonproject.exp_burner.extract_toolt: Click to extract all accumulated EXP
gui.moonproject.exp_burner.fuel_desc1: Accepts books, enchanted books, and written books
gui.moonproject.exp_burner.fuel_desc2: Also supports coal, lava, and standard fuels
tooltip.moonproject.containment_unit: Lobotomy Corp primary containment facility. Holds abnormality cores, monitors Qlipoth counter, and prevents meltdowns.
tooltip.moonproject.enkephalin_extractor: Consumes catalysts to extract pure Enkephalin from adjacent containment units at the cost of Qlipoth stability.
tooltip.moonproject.meltdown_siren: Facility disaster emergency siren. Sounds air raid alarm during Qlipoth meltdowns or redstone signals, buffing responders and revealing hostiles.
tooltip.moonproject.bookbinding_table: Library of Ruina Keter floor crafting table. Compiles fragments of Light into books and combat pages, soothing the mind upon reading.
tooltip.moonproject.identity_extractor: Limbus Company Singularity extraction facility. Consumes fragments, E.G.O cores, or exp bottles to pull mirror identities across dimensions.
tooltip.moonproject.mephistopheles_engin: Bio-mechanical diesel engine of the Limbus bus. Devours organic remains to sustain power and broadcast healing resonance to seated passengers.
tooltip.moonproject.kcorp_injector: K-Corp Singularity industrial facility. Stores nanite tear fluid, generates an aerosol healing mist, and fills ampoules into glass bottles.
tooltip.moonproject.golden_bough_shrine: Seed of Light sacred pedestal. Inserting a Golden Bough projects a celestial pillar of light, establishing a 48-block panic-immune sanctuary.
tooltip.moonproject.reinforced_plating: Heavy reinforced plating for Lobotomy Corp facilities. Boasts extreme blast resistance; surrounding containment units significantly slows Qlipoth decay.
